doc.name: PepVault
doc.instructions: PepVault (https://pepvault.app) is a peptide reference site. These tools return its published pages: each compound's reference page and Dose Guide, vial reconstitution charts, study summaries, side-by-side comparisons, a glossary and guides. Every page result is the page's own Markdown with its source URL and last-updated date, the link to cite. Dose figures are the ranges studies used, never a dose for a person, and the reconstitution tool is arithmetic on the numbers given. Start with get_peptide for a named compound, search_pepvault for anything else.

tools.name: search_pepvault
tools.title: Search PepVault
tools.description: Search PepVault's peptide library, dose guides, vial charts, study summaries, comparisons, glossary and guides. For questions that don't name one compound or term. Returns up to 8 pages with title, URL, type and description.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words ("retatrutide half-life", "how to mix a 5 mg vial").

tools.name: get_peptide
tools.title: Get a peptide's reference page
tools.description: Get one compound's reference page: what it is, the dose range studies used, how often, half-life, side effects and how strong the evidence is. Takes a peptide's or GLP-1's name; brand names and aliases work (Ozempic and Wegovy open semaglutide).

name.description: The compound's name, a brand name or an alias ("BPC-157", "Ozempic", "tirzepatide").

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

tools.name: get_dose_reference
tools.title: Get a peptide's dose guide
tools.description: Get one compound's Dose Guide page: the dose ranges studies used, how often, and a typical run length. For questions about dosing amounts or schedules. These are research ranges, never a dose for a person.

name.description: The compound's name, a brand name or an alias.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

tools.name: reconstitution
tools.title: Reconstitution arithmetic
tools.description: Work out a mixed vial's strength, the units to read on a U-100 insulin syringe for a given amount, and how many doses the vial holds, from the vial's mg, the water's mL and the amount. Arithmetic on the numbers given, the same math as PepVault's calculator, not a dose recommendation.

vial_mg.description: The vial's amount of powder, in mg.

dose.description: The amount to draw, in dose_unit.

compound.description: The compound in the vial, to link its vial chart.

syringe_ml.description: The U-100 insulin syringe's size in mL (0.3, 0.5 or 1), to check the amount fits.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.title: List a peptide's studies
tools.description: List the study summaries PepVault has published for one compound, each with its page and PubMed link.

compound.description: The compound's name, a brand name or an alias.

limit.description: How many studies, at most (default 10, up to 25).

tools.name: get_study
tools.title: Get a study summary
tools.description: Get one study summary: what the study tested, how it was done, what it found, its limits and the takeaway. Takes the study's slug, its pepvault.app URL or its PubMed id.

id.description: The study's slug ("bpc-157-chang-2011"), its pepvault.app URL, or its PubMed id.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

tools.name: compare_peptides
tools.title: Compare two peptides
tools.description: Get PepVault's side-by-side page for two compounds (for example BPC-157 and TB-500): how they differ and which does what. When no comparison page exists it returns each compound's page link.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

tools.name: define_term
tools.title: Define a peptide term
tools.description: Get the glossary entry for a peptide or dosing term (half-life, bacteriostatic water, U-100 syringe, titration): what the word means.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Get a PepVault page
tools.description: Get a pepvault.app reference page by its path or URL (for example /guides/where-to-inject-peptides), as its published Markdown. It reads the reference pages listed on pepvault.app, not the pages about the PepVault app.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).
